mapper.insert: INSERT INTO product_physical_ext (product_id, stock, delivery_type, refund_rule, extension_json, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{productId}, #{stock}, #{deliveryType}, #{refundRule}, #{extensionJson}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT product_id, stock, delivery_type, refund_rule, extension_json, created_at, updated_at FROM product_physical_ext WHERE product_id = #{productId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO product_virtual_ext (product_id, valid_days, verification_type, store_ids, extension_json, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{productId}, #{validDays}, #{verificationType}, #{storeIds, typeHandler=com.example.product.repository.typehandler.LongListJsonTypeHandler}, #{extensionJson}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT product_id, valid_days, verification_type, store_ids, extension_json, created_at, updated_at FROM product_virtual_ext WHERE product_id = #{productId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO product_material_ext (product_id, media_type, media_url, license_end_time, extension_json, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{productId}, #{mediaType}, #{mediaUrl}, #{licenseEndTime}, #{extensionJson}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT product_id, media_type, media_url, license_end_time, extension_json, created_at, updated_at FROM product_material_ext WHERE product_id = #{productId}
